skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the characteristics, roles, motivations, and impacts of multinational corporations on host countries.
Analyze the factors influencing the formulation, adjustment, and implementation of policies for multinational corporations.
Apply methods and techniques to collect, analyze, and evaluate economic data and information for policy-making.
Work independently and collaboratively in groups to solve problems related to multinational corporations.
Understand the trends and impacts of globalization on multinational corporations and investment policies.
Understand and analyze international investment agreements and their implications for multinational corporations.
Analyze Vietnam's policies towards multinational corporations and their investments.
Evaluate the positive and negative impacts of multinational corporations on developing countries, particularly Vietnam.
Formulate appropriate policies to leverage positive impacts and mitigate negative impacts of multinational corporations.
Present and discuss case studies and group projects effectively.
